recipe.name: Peru Picante
recipe.description: A vibrant and fiery drink combining lush, tropical pink guava with the sharp heat of chilli shrub, rounded out by smooth tequila and aromatic coriander notes.
steps: Add the Camino Blanco, pink guava juice, chilli shrub, and coriander tincture to a cocktail shaker.
Fill the shaker with ice cubes and shake vigorously for 10-15 seconds until well chilled.
Strain the mixture into an ice-filled rocks glass.
recipe.garnish: A slice of fresh red chilli
recipe.serving: Serve immediately cold over fresh ice.
